build_image_feature: build a dataset column using the Image feature class to load and decode image files from paths
encode_image_example: encode a PIL image or numpy array into an Arrow compatible dict with path and bytes fields
decode_image_example: decode an Arrow stored image dict back into a PIL Image object with optional mode conversion
cast_image_storage: cast a PyArrow string or binary array into the Image struct storage type with bytes and path fields
embed_image_storage: embed local or remote image file bytes into a PyArrow struct array for self contained dataset storage
